method: Verify the latest revenue filing separately for every reviewed annual period. Match the primary income-statement total, issuer, annual date column, USD scale and exact source fact within displayed rounding. Pin the accession, filing date and amount; a tag approval never transfers to another filing automatically. Four exact note exceptions verify consolidated totals or historical annual corrections.
definition: Reported consolidated revenue on the income statement's tax/interest basis. Reviewed banks use GAAP net interest income plus noninterest income from one filing. Overlapping concepts are never summed; different sectors are not normalized.
